summary: Bandelier Lookout: CCC-built 1940-41 NPS two-story wood cab on stone basement, in use to at least 2016, listed standing, NHLR-registered 2022.

facts.design: Two-story wood cab on a stone basement, NPS standardized lookout drawing PG-3040
facts.agency: National Park Service - Bandelier National Monument

events.note: Constructed 1940-41 by the Civilian Conservation Corps for the National Park Service
Los Alamos National Lab set up next to the monument (register credits the Atomic Energy Commission, which did not exist until 1947; the story omits that attribution)
Santa Fe National Forest, AEC and the monument made a cooperative agreement for detection and suppression
Register says the lookout was actively used to at least 2016
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register on July 7, 2022

corrections.why: The NHLR Built field and description give 1940-41, not a single year

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR register places the lookout in Los Alamos County; a West Lookouts listing gives Sandoval County. The story follows the register.

sources.title: The Civilian Conservation Corps at Bandelier

notes_for_editor: Core facts (build, design, elevation, 2016 use, 2022 registration) rest on the NHLR page and are corroborated for the CCC build by the NPS page. Not verified: whether the cab is open to visitors or rented, current staffing, and any fire history; the story says so. Could not read the NPS Historic Structure Report entry for B-30 'Fire Lookout' (hsr4c30.htm): fetch_text returned the Park History index page, and a search snippet says it was built in 1941 on former USFS land. Not used as evidence because no page text was quotable; worth a retry. County conflict: NHLR says Los Alamos County, West Lookouts says Sandoval County. Photo license not stated on the source page; the two NHLR image URLs are listed without query strings. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the register credits the 1943 lab set-up to the Atomic Energy Commission, which was created by the Atomic Energy Act of 1946 and began operating in 1947; the story drops that attribution. This dating is from general knowledge, not from the sources here. The NPS CCC page contains no mention of the lookout (checked by grep). The 1940-41 correction is left for human review; events.year stays an integer, matching the other records.
